goal: Target unreviewed CLOS exact method semantics and class evolution; make Interlisp source analysis & Scheme continuation control explicit holds; do not duplicate merged old MacLisp/PSL or open R6RS/R7RS review.

rows.observable_law: Pure lookup by exact ordered qualifiers and specializers within one generic function; it does not select all methods applicable to runtime arguments.
rows.positive_witness: A generic function has :before method specialized on class C and primary method on C: lookup :before yields only :before; with errorp false absent signature yields NIL.
rows.falsifier: Do not treat APPLICABLE-METHODS result as identical; searching by runtime applicability may return a method with a different qualifier/signature.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: DEFGENERIC, DEFMETHOD and #4800 APPLICABLE-METHODS already exist as different definition/applicability operations.

rows.observable_law: Remove one particular method object from its generic function without removing the generic function or unrelated methods. Removing a method that is not present must not signal an error.
rows.positive_witness: Given two methods on one generic function, removing method A leaves B; removing A again does not signal an error.
rows.falsifier: Deletion of an entire generic function or arbitrary method based on print-name instead of method identity is not equivalent.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: D10 DEFMETHOD; D9 REMD removes named definition, not one method of a generic function.

rows.observable_law: Transform an instance to a new class destructively while retaining the original object's identity, retaining values of same-name slots and leaving previously unbound common slots unbound.
rows.positive_witness: Instance x has common slot p=7 and class A; change to B that also has p; result is EQ-identical x with p=7 and valid new class.
rows.falsifier: Returning a fresh instance, losing a common slot, or binding an originally unbound common slot as a side effect violates the law.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: D10 DEFCLASS, MAKE-INSTANCE, SLOT-VALUE; this is not constructor equivalence.

rows.observable_law: Attach an existing method object to a generic function, updating dispatch membership under agreement rules; assess whether action is derivable from already selected DEFMETHOD or a new effect law.
rows.positive_witness: After adding a :before method its descriptor can be found; unaffected primary methods still exist.
rows.falsifier: Registering a method under a different generic function or duplicating agreeing signatures without replacement policy is invalid.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: D10 DEFMETHOD, DEFGENERIC and pending FIND-METHOD; mutable generic function identity requires owner review.

rows.observable_law: Customization hook triggered during CHANGE-CLASS, receiving an ephemeral copy of the prior instance and the altered current instance; not a standalone call for user code.
rows.positive_witness: Transition A->B invokes hook after preserving shared slots; hook can read old-only slot from ephemeral previous object.
rows.falsifier: Calling hook as an independent public operation, treating previous as persistent, or assuming its return value is a general semantic result is not allowed.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: Possibly subsumed by CHANGE-CLASS lifecycle; scope and effect ownership must be determined.

rows.observable_law: Create a fresh instance of a class without standard MAKE-INSTANCE initialization; standard-class slots are initially unbound.
rows.positive_witness: Allocate then inspect slot-boundness: slots are unbound, whereas make-instance may apply initform/initargs.
rows.falsifier: Confusing allocated instance with fully initialized MAKE-INSTANCE result is a semantic failure.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: D10 MAKE-INSTANCE, D8 MAKE-CLOSURE and existing type laws; independent constructor slot requires distinctness proof.

rows.observable_law: Resolve a symbolic record field label to a location in the current declared record layout; after layout redefinition the same field name resolves to the new offset.
rows.positive_witness: Fields of PERSON change from FIRSTNAME LASTNAME TITLE to FIRSTNAME INITIAL LASTNAME TITLE: TITLE changes from third to fourth field without modifying field-name references.
rows.falsifier: Keeping a stale fixed CADDR reference after schema redefinition violates source-level record meaning.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: Compare D10 SLOT-VALUE, D8 DEFSTRUCT and D2-controlled compilation; likely derivable from schema and lookup, not new language control.

rows.observable_law: A static program relation query over indexed sources (e.g., who calls a given function and uses a bound/free variable); treat as analysis tooling unless independent universal law is demonstrated.
rows.positive_witness: Same source graph yields stable caller set regardless of traversal/reindexing; free-variable query distinguishes bound from free occurrences.
rows.falsifier: Text-only name occurrence or a tooling UI query with no binding analysis is not equivalent to a source semantic relation.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: D10 MY-BUILD-DEPENDENCY-GRAPH, COLLECT-FREE-VARS already selected; likely composition/tool feature.

rows.observable_law: Run before/after hooks whenever a captured continuation reenters/exits dynamic extent, not only at normal function call/return.
rows.positive_witness: Captured continuation reentered after nonlocal exit repeats before and then after; ordered event trace must match Scheme specification.
rows.falsifier: Running before/after only once despite continuation reentry violates the required trace.
rows.dedup_or_owner_question: D10 CALL/CC already selected but user mandates D2 as only structural/control authority. Research #4837 covers this, do not mint D10 control.
